1. The instant application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been filed on behalf of applicant seeking grant of interim bail in case FIR bearing no. 450/2023 registered at Police Station Patel Nagar, Delhi for offence punishable under Sections 376/201/385/452/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC') on the ground of marriage of sister of the applicant.
2. Briefly stated, the facts of the case are that on 27.06.2023, prosecutrix had filed a complaint of sexual assault against accused/applicant.

As per the complaint filed by prosecutrix, in April of 2023,

sentences.text: The present FIR was registered on the complaint of the prosecutrix, and Consequently, accused/applicant was arrested on 10.07.2023.

The chargesheet in the present case was filed on 06.09.2023, and supplementary chargesheet was filed on 21.09.2023.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant states that applicant herein has been falsely implicated in present case.
He also states that the marriage of his sister is coming up on 23.11.2023.
He further states that applicant is the only son and brother in the family and his presence in the rituals is important.
Therefore, bail application be allowed.
4. Learned APP for the State, on the other hand, states that the factum of marriage of sister of the applicant has been filed and the same has been verified.
It is stated that the residential address of the accused also stands verified and has no objection if applicant is released on interim bail.
5. I have heard arguments addressed on behalf of applicant and the State and have perused material on record.

6. The allegations against applicant, in a nutshell, are that he had sexually assaulted the prosecutrix and had extorted money from her by blackmailing her with the objectionable videos made without her consent and had also shared her phone numbers to his friends.
This Court notes that This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/11/2023 at 01:10:54 the allegations levelled against the applicant are of serious nature, however, this Court also notes that he has been in judicial custody since 10.07.2023 and that he is the only brother and his presence in the rituals of marriage of his sister are required.
At this juncture, present applicant has approached this Court for grant of interim bail on account of marriage of his sister.

7. In light of the circumstances of the case and also the fact that the applicant is the only son and brother in the family and since the factum of his sister's marriage is verified by the State, this Court is inclined to grant interim bail to the applicant for a period of 10 days beginning from 19.11.2023 to 28.11.2023.

8. Accordingly, on applicant furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Successor Court/Link Court/Duty Judge concerned, applicant shall be released on interim bail for a period of 10 days beginning from 19.11.2023 to 28.11.2023.
i. The applicant will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
ii. The applicant shall provide his permanent address to the learned Trial Court and shall intimate the Court immediately by way of an affidavit in case of change of address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
